name: site_audit
description: Audits every page linked from <base>/index.html (status, title, h1Count, sorted distinct broken link hrefs) and writes the JSON to outPath. Returns a short summary.
whenToUse: When asked to (re-)audit the small local website into audit.json.

outPath.description: absolute path of audit.json to write

provenance.reason: audit 30 pages, repeated on future deploys
